heroHeadline: Day 89: CJNG War on Nahua Communities — 3 Attacks in 3 Days; Nigeria Meth Superlab Busted; El Sapo Hunt Day 89; 20 Days to FIFA World Cup
heroSubtitle: Day 89 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). CJNG MICHOACÁN ESCALATION (May 22): La Jornada ('Arrecian ataques del CJNG contra comunidades nahuas de Michoacán') reports CJNG launched three armed attacks against the Nahua communities of La Cofradía and Ostula in Aquila, Michoacán between May 19–21 — including a sustained hour-long assault at 9:00 AM on May 19 and a second incursion repelled May 21 at 6:20 AM. Seven total attacks in 18 months; 42 homicides and 5 disappearances documented. Communities issued urgent demand for federal military deployment. CNI (National Indigenous Congress) documented dozens of armed incursions, drone attacks, and explosive devices. NIGERIA METH SUPERLAB BUST (May 16–21): Nigeria's NDLEA raided a clandestine forest meth lab in Ogun State on May 16 — 2,419 kg seized, 3 Mexican nationals arrested (street value: $362.9M / N480 billion). DEA confirmed CJNG/Sinaloa franchise networks link. Together with South Africa Swarttruggens bust (May 13: 481 kg, 11 arrested including 5 Mexican nationals) and U.S. AFRICOM's Congressional testimony (May 20), CJNG's Africa meth expansion is now confirmed across West Africa (Nigeria) + Southern Africa (South Africa) + Chile — a three-continent transnational manufacturing arc entirely independent of the Manzanillo/Jalisco fentanyl core, resilient to 89 days of decapitation pressure. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 89: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's #1 CJNG enforcement target. PLAN KUKULKAN — 20 DAYS: Twenty days to the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca). Guadalajara (Akron Stadium, 4 group-stage matches) under heightened CJNG-specific protocols. CJNG's ongoing Nahua community attacks ahead of World Cup intensify international scrutiny. LAGOS DE MORENO CREMATORIO (ONGOING): FGE Jalisco forensics continue — 16+ burning pits; no official victim count. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 13: Thirteen days since El Chucky arrest (May 9), no successor named. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 89): Ongoing — treason charge line active. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader, financial wing) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14; Lagos de Moreno linked), El Chucky/Manzanillo (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ confirmed CJNG HVTs neutralized.
